remarks: Nestled on a quiet neighborhood, this quintessential cape exudes charm and elegance. The house boasts a brand new kitchen, complete with state-of-the-art appliances, and new washer/dryer. Recently painted walls and beautifully finished hardwood floors add a touch of sophistication to the interior. A plush new carpet runner offers both comfort and style. With immediate availability, you can move in and start enjoying the space right away.  The first floor of this home features a spacious living room, dining room, cozy den/office and one full bath. Additionally, there is a delightful three-season sunroom, perfect for relaxation and soaking up the sunlight. Upstairs, you will discover three inviting bedrooms, ensuring ample space for everyone, along with the additional full bath.
